ui_bugs.issue: Tenant skin does NOT apply on /admin/login?tenant=DEMO-CORP. Two root causes: (a) AdminLogin.jsx never calls useTenantSkin() — only AdminDashboard does. (b) useTenantSkin only reads window.location.search — never falls back to sessionStorage. So even if the login page called it, after successful login the router redirects to /admin (no query string) and the hook returns without applying anything, so --brand-navy stays at default #0b1e3f and the 'Portal · Demo Corporate Client' tenant chip never renders. Verified: getComputedStyle(documentElement).getPropertyValue('--brand-navy') === '' on login page, and admin-tenant-chip data-testid not present on dashboard after login-with-tenant flow.
React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. Cosmetic dev-mode warning caused by ve-dynamic instrumentation wrapping option text in <span>. Not user-facing.

action_items: Fix useTenantSkin.js: (1) On mount, if URL has ?tenant=CODE, fetch + apply + store in sessionStorage as today. (2) Otherwise, if sessionStorage.getItem('pmc.tenant') exists, hydrate from it and re-apply --brand-navy so the skin survives the login redirect. (3) Wire useTenantSkin() into AdminLogin.jsx (and VendorLogin.jsx if not already) so the purple background applies on the login page itself, per the spec: 'Visiting /admin/login?tenant=DEMO-CORP applies a purple skin'.
critical_code_review_comments: useTenantSkin.js stores tenant to sessionStorage but never reads it back — dead code path unless callers rehydrate.
AdminLogin.jsx should invoke useTenantSkin() so tenants can preview their portal branding BEFORE authenticating.
matrix_helper.active_step performs an extra db.notices lookup per bid inside list_all_bids (N+1). Consider a $lookup or precomputing active_step on status transitions.
vendor_auth.gdpr-forget accepts arbitrary dict payload — no pydantic model; if password key is missing the endpoint 401s but a stricter model with password: str (min_length=1) would be better.
audit-copilot swallows LLM exceptions silently into a '(AI narrative unavailable: TypeName)' string — good for UX, but a WARN-level log would help ops.

staff_auth HIGH_RISK_ROLES enforcement is correct, but the message 'Sign in as admin first and enable Two-Factor' assumes the same user also holds admin role — for a pure escrow_agent this instruction is confusing. Consider softening to 'Contact your administrator to enable MFA'.

KYC stub's deterministic risk_score (hash % 100) is fine for demo, but the endpoint should reject empty vendor_ref before calling verification (currently .encode() on empty string still works and returns risk 68).

rca of the issue: Tenant skin bug: useTenantSkin.js reads only from URL query string. On /admin/login?tenant=DEMO-CORP the AdminLogin component does not invoke the hook, so login page shows default PMC navy. After successful auth, react-router navigates to /admin (WITHOUT preserving ?tenant=), AdminDashboard mounts and calls useTenantSkin, but new URL has no tenant param → hook early-returns and never reads sessionStorage.getItem('pmc.tenant'). Fix: (a) add sessionStorage rehydrate fallback in the useEffect; (b) call useTenantSkin() in AdminLogin.jsx (and vendor/staff logins if desired). Verified reproduction: Playwright evaluated getComputedStyle var --brand-navy == '' on login page and admin-tenant-chip element not found on /admin after tenant-scoped login.
